96b_wistrio/stm32l151xba.name: renode
96b_wistrio/stm32l151xba.scope: CPU boot and USART1 console; clock readiness is modeled because the upstream STM32L151 fixed PLLRDY tag cannot model PLL disable. Radio, sensors, electrical behavior and physical hardware remain untested.

nrf52840dk/nrf52840.name: renode
nrf52840dk/nrf52840.scope: Upstream Renode nRF52840 DK model: CPU boot and UARTE0 console. Radio, USB, QSPI flash, electrical behavior and physical hardware remain untested.
